text:
sara_mkt: quick plan check 1  we need SEO-ready assets for next week's webinar push: landing, hero post, 3 pillars, thanks page. deliverables: redirect CSV, keyword clusters, JSON-LD, anchor map, UTM templates. target: Tue EOD for QA.

lee_seo: i'll do keyword clusters (3 longtails/page) + redirect CSV. keep canonical targets tight.

toni_prod: which messaging variant for metas? performance favours product-benefit copy or cost-savings?

mike_growth: cost-savings wins on cold. recommend cost-savings in meta desc and H1; keep CTA "see demo".

lee_seo: sample redirect CSV snippet:

```csv
old_path,new_path,type,reason
/blog/launch-draft,/blog/launch-hero,301,merge dupes
/webinar-alpha,/webinar,302,temp validate tracking
/offer/old,/thanks,301,consolidate
```

lee_seo: schema plan: webinar -> Event JSON-LD (name,startDate,url,organizer). blogs -> BlogPosting with mainEntityOfPage + image. i'll attach full snippets to ticket.

toni_prod: anchor map: hero -> pillar A & B in intro; webinar -> pillar C + thanks in CTA. use natural anchor text.

ian_eng: redirect run Wed 05:00-06:00 UTC. flow: apply 302s, smoke test analytics, flip to 301. SRE on watch. we'll also add rel=canonical Link header on duplicates.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #MK-7788 "Webinar SEO bundle: redirects + schema + anchors" assignees: lee_seo, toni_prod, mike_growth, ian_eng. Reminder set for 2024-06-10T09:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

sara_mkt: thanks all 1 i'll preflight Tue after submissions. :rocket:
